referee_caveats_inferred: ALMA is a minor part: only upper limits for one SMC source, with no processing details
Stack flux correction factors and SED fit parameters are shown only in figures
Dust yield depends strongly on assumed LBV phase duration and LBV fraction, so the 1e4 to 1e5 Msun range is weakly constrained
Stack dominated by a few sources, notably RMC 143, and confusion-limited at far-infrared wavelengths
Single grey body with assumed kappa and beta may miss cold dust
